fields.stem: Arrange the following words in the order they would appear in a dictionary, from first to last: (A) Tiger (B) Tablet (C) Table (D) Tail (E) Tab. Choose the correct sequence from the options given below.
fields.explanation: Dictionary order compares letters from left to right. Tab comes before Table because it is a prefix of it, and Table comes before Tablet for the same reason. Tablet comes before Tail because b precedes i at the third letter, and Tail comes before Tiger because a precedes i at the second letter. The order is Tab, Table, Tablet, Tail, Tiger, which is (E), (C), (B), (D), (A).

fields.stem: Lata is taller than Mohan. Kiran is taller than Lata. Neha is shorter than Mohan but taller than Om. Arrange the following five persons from the tallest to the shortest: (A) Neha (B) Lata (C) Om (D) Kiran (E) Mohan. Choose the correct sequence from the options given below.
fields.explanation: Chain the comparisons: Kiran > Lata > Mohan from the first two clues, and Mohan > Neha > Om from the third. Combining the chains gives the full order Kiran, Lata, Mohan, Neha, Om, which is (D), (B), (E), (A), (C). Check a sequence against every clue, since one wrong adjacent pair rules it out.

fields.stem: Five books (P), (Q), (R), (S) and (T) are placed on a shelf from left to right. S is at the left end. P is immediately to the right of R. Q is to the right of P but not next to P. Which arrangement from left to right is correct?
fields.explanation: S fixes the first place. R and P must then take two consecutive places among the second to the fifth, with P right after R. If P were in the fourth place, the only place to its right is the fifth, which is next to P, and if P were in the fifth place Q would have no place to its right. So R is in the second place and P in the third. Q must then be in the fifth place, to the right of P without touching it, which leaves T in the fourth place: S, R, P, T, Q.
